name: Package tracking
author: Bulwark
description: Finds tracking numbers in your mail, shows where each parcel is and tells you when its status changes.

track17Url.label: 17TRACK API address
track17Url.description: Base address of the 17TRACK API v2.2. Leave the default unless you use a test server.

track17Token.label: 17TRACK API key
track17Token.description: Security key from the 17TRACK API dashboard (sent as the 17token header). Covers every carrier.

dhlUrl.label: DHL tracking API address
dhlUrl.description: Address of the DHL Shipment Tracking - Unified API.

dhlKey.label: DHL API key
dhlKey.description: API key from developer.dhl.com (sent as the DHL-API-Key header). Used for DHL parcels.
